semiconductor_relevance: High — Ningbo Alpha Semiconductor specializes in the production of compound semiconductor substrates, particularly SiC, which are critical for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Ningbo Alpha Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the research, production, and sales of new materials, particularly compound semiconductor substrates such as SiC. The company has established significant production capabilities and has developed advanced technologies in SiC crystal growth.
capabilities: Production of 6-inch and 8-inch conductive and semi-insulating SiC substrates
Development of 12-inch SiC crystal growth and processing technology
Manufacturing of high-purity SiC powder and ceramic powder

regional_presence.China: The company has a significant manufacturing presence in China, including a factory area of 40,000 square meters and a subsidiary focused on high-purity materials.
